items.title: Neil Young and the Chrome Hearts :: Second Song
items.summary: At 80, Neil Young remains gloriously unfinished. Second Song , his latest with the Chrome Hearts, is a weathered, luminous meditation on memory, mortality, love, and the strange passage of time. With shimmering textures, warm harmonies, wandering tempos, and that unmistakably vulnerable voice, Young looks backward without quite letting go of the future. An elegiac, deeply human record from an artist still searching for the song. The post Neil Young and the Chrome Hearts :: Second Song first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
